# @scell/sdk — JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for Scell.io
> Version: 3.2.0 | License: MIT | Node.js >= 18.0.0 | TypeScript >= 5.0.0

## v3.2.0 (2026-06-11) — Document live preview + branding direct upload / overrides + template colors

New endpoints from the branding/previews batch (api.flexible group: `sk_*`/`pk_*`
+ Sanctum). Everything exposed on **both** `ScellClient` (Bearer) and
`ScellApiClient` (`sk_*`).

### Document live preview — `client.documents`

`POST /documents/preview` renders a NON-PERSISTED HTML preview of a document
being drafted (invoice / credit note / quote), through the REAL pipeline:
invoice template + branding + legal mentions of the issuing Company. Nothing
is saved; no number is consumed. Only `type` is required.

| Endpoint | SDK method |
|----------|------------|
| `POST /documents/preview` | `client.documents.preview(input)` → `Promise<string>` (raw HTML) |

```typescript
const html = await client.documents.preview({
  type: 'invoice', // 'invoice' | 'credit_note' | 'quote' (required)
  document_number: 'FAC-2026-0001',          // ≤ 100 chars
  buyer: {
    name: 'ACME SAS', siret: '12345678900012', vat_number: 'FR32123456789',
    email: 'compta@acme.fr', phone: '+33100000000', is_individual: false,
    address: { line1: '1 rue de la Paix', line2: 'Bât. B', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
  },
  lines: [ // max 200
    { description: 'Consulting', quantity: 2, unit_price: 800, tax_rate: 20 },
  ],
  issue_date: '2026-06-11', due_date: '2026-07-11', // YYYY-MM-DD
  currency: 'EUR',            // 3 chars
  notes: '...',               // ≤ 2000 chars
  payment_terms: '...',       // ≤ 2000 chars
});
// render in <iframe srcDoc={html} /> for a live preview. 422 on invalid payload.
```

Types: `DocumentPreviewInput`, `DocumentPreviewType`, `DocumentPreviewBuyer`,
`DocumentPreviewBuyerAddress`, `DocumentPreviewLine`.

### Branding — direct logo upload (multipart) + preview overrides

| Endpoint | SDK method |
|----------|------------|
| `POST /branding/tenant/logo` | `client.branding.tenant.uploadLogoFile(logo, filename?)` |
| `POST /branding/sub-tenants/{id}/logo` | `client.branding.subTenants.uploadLogoFile(id, logo, filename?)` |
| `GET /branding/tenant/preview?...overrides` | `client.branding.tenant.preview(overrides?)` |
| `GET /branding/sub-tenants/{id}/preview?...overrides` | `client.branding.subTenants.preview(id, overrides?)` |

`uploadLogoFile` uploads the email logo DIRECTLY in one multipart call (field
`logo`, jpeg/png/webp/svg/svgz, max 2 MB) — alternative to the pre-signed flow
(`uploadLogo`). Returns the updated **flat** branding object (same shape as
`tenant.get()`, NOT wrapped in `{ data }`). Sub-tenant variant: 404 anti-IDOR.

```typescript
const branding = await client.branding.tenant.uploadLogoFile(file); // Blob | File | Uint8Array
console.log(branding.brand_logo_url);
```

`preview` accepts optional NON-PERSISTED overrides (`BrandingPreviewOverrides`,
query string — only defined keys are sent): `brand_primary_color` (#RRGGBB),
`brand_email_footer` (≤2000), `brand_email_signature` (≤1000),
`brand_logo_url` (≤2048). Render a draft without saving each keystroke:

```typescript
const draft = await client.branding.tenant.preview({ brand_primary_color: '#FF5722' });
// signature change: requestOptions is now the 2nd (tenant) / 3rd (sub-tenant) arg
const pdf = await client.branding.tenant.preview(undefined, { headers: { Accept: 'application/pdf' } });
```

New `Branding` fields: `brand_email_enabled` (boolean — master switch; `false`
= platform default branding even if custom fields are filled; also writable on
`UpdateBrandingInput`) and `computed_email_footer` (string | null, read-only —
footer computed from the issuing company, used when `brand_email_footer` is empty).

### Invoice templates — colors from email logo + `is_enabled`

| Endpoint | SDK method |
|----------|------------|
| `POST /invoice-templates/derive-colors-from-email-logo` | `client.invoiceTemplates.deriveColorsFromEmailLogo()` |

Derives primary/accent colors from the tenant email logo and applies them to
the default invoice template (created on the fly if absent). No body; returns
the updated `InvoiceTemplate` (unwrapped from `{ data }`). Errors: 404 when no
email logo exists; 422 when the logo is unreachable or its colors are too neutral.

New `InvoiceTemplate.is_enabled` (boolean, default `true`): when `false`, the
template is skipped by the resolution cascade (fallback to the system
template). Also accepted on `CreateInvoiceTemplateInput` / `UpdateInvoiceTemplateInput`:

```typescript
await client.invoiceTemplates.update(templateId, { is_enabled: false });
const template = await client.invoiceTemplates.deriveColorsFromEmailLogo();
```

## v2.38.0 (2026-06-07) — Product/service catalog (Products + ProductCategories)

Reusable catalog scoped by `(tenant, sub_tenant)`, mirroring the buyer registry
(`client.buyers`). Reuse a product to pre-fill an invoice/quote line via
`product_id` without re-typing label, unit price and VAT rate. Like a buyer, the
catalog carries the *current* state of the article — mutating a product does not
affect already-issued invoices (snapshot, ISCA). Resources exposed on **both**
`ScellClient` (Bearer) and `ScellApiClient` (`sk_*`), next to `buyers`.

Endpoints:

| Endpoint | SDK method |
|----------|------------|
| `GET /products` | `client.products.list(params?)` |
| `POST /products` | `client.products.create(input)` |
| `GET /products/{id}` | `client.products.get(id)` |
| `PATCH /products/{id}` | `client.products.update(id, input)` |
| `PUT /products/{id}` | `client.products.replace(id, input)` |
| `DELETE /products/{id}` | `client.products.delete(id)` |
| `GET /product-categories` | `client.productCategories.list(params?)` |
| `POST /product-categories` | `client.productCategories.create(input)` |
| `GET /product-categories/{id}` | `client.productCategories.get(id)` |
| `PATCH /product-categories/{id}` | `client.productCategories.update(id, input)` |
| `PUT /product-categories/{id}` | `client.productCategories.replace(id, input)` |
| `DELETE /product-categories/{id}` | `client.productCategories.delete(id)` |

List filters — products: `q`, `revenue_category`, `product_category_id`,
`is_active`, `per_page`, `page`. Categories: `q`, `per_page`, `page`.

```typescript
const api = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_...');

// Create a category + a product filed under it
const cat = await api.productCategories.create({ name: 'Consulting', color: '#0066FF' });
const product = await api.products.create({
  name: 'Consulting',
  unit_price_ht: 800,
  default_tax_rate: 20,
  unit: 'HUR',
  product_category_id: cat.id,
});

// Reuse the product to pre-fill an invoice line
await api.invoices.create({
  // ...
  lines: [{ product_id: product.id, quantity: 2, /* totals... */ }],
});
```

Invoice/quote line catalog fields (optional, on `InvoiceLineInput` and
`QuoteLineInput`): `product_id` (pre-fills the line), `save_to_catalog`
(server-side upsert of the line as a product), `product_category_id` (files the
saved product under a category).

`Product` type: `id`, `tenant_id`, `sub_tenant_id`, `product_category_id`,
`name`, `description`, `sku`, `revenue_category` (`goods`|`service`|`accommodation`|null),
`revenue_category_label`, `unit` (default `C62`), `unit_price_ht`,
`default_tax_rate`, `default_discount_rate`, `currency` (default `EUR`),
`is_active`, `product_category` (nested), `metadata`, `notes`, timestamps.
`ProductCategory` type: `id`, `tenant_id`, `sub_tenant_id`, `name`, `color`,
`description`, `position`, `products_count?`, `metadata`, timestamps.

## v2.33.0 (2026-06-04) — Recurring invoices (subscriptions / retainers)

New `client.recurringInvoices` resource on **both** `ScellClient` (Bearer) and
`ScellApiClient` (X-API-Key). A recurring invoice **profile** bundles a buyer,
line items and a recurrence schedule; the platform emits invoices automatically
on the cadence. Each run is tracked as an **occurrence** linking to the
generated invoice. Mutating a profile only affects future runs — already-emitted
invoices stay immutable (ISCA).

### Methods (`client.recurringInvoices`)

| Method | HTTP | Returns |
|--------|------|---------|
| `list(options?)` | `GET /recurring-invoices?status&sub_tenant_id&per_page` | `PaginatedResponse<RecurringInvoiceProfile>` |
| `get(id)` | `GET /recurring-invoices/{id}` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` |
| `create(input)` | `POST /recurring-invoices` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` (201) |
| `update(id, input)` | `PUT /recurring-invoices/{id}` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` |
| `delete(id)` | `DELETE /recurring-invoices/{id}` | `MessageResponse` |
| `occurrences(id, options?)` | `GET /recurring-invoices/{id}/occurrences?per_page` | `PaginatedResponse<RecurringInvoiceOccurrence>` |
| `pause(id)` | `POST /recurring-invoices/{id}/pause` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` |
| `activate(id)` | `POST /recurring-invoices/{id}/activate` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` |
| `cancel(id)` | `POST /recurring-invoices/{id}/cancel` | `RecurringInvoiceProfile` |
| `runNow(id)` | `POST /recurring-invoices/{id}/run-now` | `MessageResponse` (202) |

### Enums

```typescript
type RecurrenceIntervalUnit  = 'day' | 'week' | 'month' | 'year';
type RecurrenceEndMode       = 'never' | 'on_date' | 'after_occurrences';
type RecurringEmissionMode   = 'draft' | 'auto_send';
type RecurringProfileStatus  = 'active' | 'paused' | 'completed' | 'cancelled';
type RecurringOccurrenceStatus = 'pending' | 'emitted' | 'failed' | 'skipped';
```

### Create a monthly subscription profile

```typescript
const profile = await client.recurringInvoices.create({
  title: 'Abonnement mensuel — Acme',
  buyer_id: buyer.id,            // registry shortcut (snapshot per emission)
  currency: 'EUR',              // default 'EUR'
  output_format: 'facturx',     // 'facturx' | 'ubl' | 'cii'
  lines: [
    { description: 'Licence SaaS', quantity: 1, unit_price: 49, vat_rate: 20 },
  ],
  recurrence: { interval_unit: 'month', interval_count: 1, day_of_month: 1 },
  start_date: '2026-07-01',
  end_mode: 'never',
  emission_mode: 'auto_send',   // emit + send each run; 'draft' to stage only
  notify_before_days: 3,
});

console.log(profile.next_run_at);       // next scheduled emission
console.log(profile.recurrence.human);  // "Tous les mois le 1er"
```

### Inspect occurrences, control the lifecycle

```typescript
const { data: runs } = await client.recurringInvoices.occurrences(profile.id);
for (const run of runs) {
  console.log(run.occurrence_number, run.status, run.invoice_number);
}

await client.recurringInvoices.pause(profile.id);     // halt
await client.recurringInvoices.activate(profile.id);  // resume
await client.recurringInvoices.runNow(profile.id);    // emit out-of-band (202)
await client.recurringInvoices.cancel(profile.id);    // permanent stop
```

### Buyer resolution

Provide the buyer via `buyer_id` (recommended — the registry's current state is
snapshotted onto each emission) **or** inline `buyer_*` fields (`buyer_name`,
`buyer_country`, `buyer_is_individual`, `buyer_siret`, `buyer_vat_number`,
`buyer_email`, `buyer_address`, `buyer_shipping_address`).

## v2.10.0 (2026-05-15) — Fix 500 on fiscal/closings + `ots_proof_base64`

Mirror of the backend fix shipped the same day. `GET /tenant/fiscal/closings`
returned a generic 500 ("Scell API error: Server Error") every time a daily
closing had been anchored to OpenTimestamps: the raw `ots_proof` BYTEA
column (non-UTF8 magic bytes from the `.ots` format) made `json_encode()`
crash with `InvalidArgumentException: Type is not supported`.

The API now exposes the OTS receipt encoded in base64. This SDK:

- Enriches the `FiscalClosing` type with all backend fields:
  `sub_tenant_id`, `first_sequence_number`, `last_sequence_number`,
  `closing_hash`, `previous_closing_hash`, `totals`, `cumulative_totals`,
  `csv_path`, `csv_hash`, `ots_proof_base64`, `ots_status`,
  `ots_submitted_at`, `ots_bitcoin_confirmed_at`, `ots_calendars`,
  `metadata`.
- Adds two new exported types: `FiscalClosingTotals` and
  `FiscalClosingOtsCalendar`.
- Stays 100% backward compatible (every new field is optional).

Decode the OpenTimestamps receipt:

```ts
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const { data } = await client.fiscal.closings();
for (const closing of data) {
  if (closing.ots_proof_base64) {
    writeFileSync(`./${closing.id}.ots`,
      Buffer.from(closing.ots_proof_base64, 'base64'));
    // Verify offline with: $ ots verify ./<id>.ots
  }
}
```

## v2.8.0 (2026-05-11) — API keys tenant-scoped (BREAKING)

The backend refonte 2026-05-11 dropped `api_keys.company_id`. API keys
are now scoped strictly to the tenant. Each `sk_*` key belongs to a
tenant; targeting a specific sub-tenant is now done per-call on the
write payload, not on the key itself.

### Breaking — `ApiKey` / `CreateApiKeyInput`

```typescript
interface ApiKey {
  id: UUID;
  name: string;
  key_prefix: string;         // first 8 chars (e.g. 'sk_live_')
  environment: Environment;
  permissions: string[];
  rate_limit: number;
  last_used_at: DateTimeString | null;
  expires_at: DateTimeString | null;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  // company_id REMOVED in 2.8.0 — keys are tenant-scoped now
}

interface CreateApiKeyInput {
  name: string;
  environment: Environment;
  permissions?: string[];
  expires_at?: DateTimeString;
  // company_id REMOVED in 2.8.0
}
```

### New — `sub_tenant_id?` on write payloads

`CreateInvoiceInput`, `CreateSignatureInput` and `CreateCreditNoteInput`
all accept an optional `sub_tenant_id: UUID`. Pass it to issue the
document under a specific sub-tenant of the authenticated tenant.

```typescript
await client.invoices.create({
  sub_tenant_id: 'sub-tenant-uuid',
  direction: 'outgoing',
  output_format: 'factur-x',
  /* ...usual fields... */
});

await client.signatures.create({
  sub_tenant_id: 'sub-tenant-uuid',
  title: 'NDA',
  document: pdfBase64,
  document_name: 'nda.pdf',
  signers: [/* ... */],
});

await client.creditNotes.create({
  sub_tenant_id: 'sub-tenant-uuid',
  invoice_id: 'invoice-uuid',
  reason: 'Refund',
  items: [/* ... */],
});
```

### Possible errors

- `401 TENANT_NOT_RESOLVED` — the `sk_*` key cannot be resolved to a
  tenant (revoked, expired, env mismatch).
- `404 SUB_TENANT_NOT_FOUND` — `sub_tenant_id` does not belong to the
  authenticated tenant (anti-IDOR).
- `422 NO_ISSUER_COMPANY` — the resolved tenant or sub-tenant has no
  Company that can issue the document. Create / select a Company first.

## v2.3.0 (2026-05-10) — Fix Sirene lookup parsing

Critical patch release. The pre-2.3.0 `CompanyData` type assumed a nested
`address.line1` shape but the real API returns flat fields
(`address_line1`, `postal_code`, `city`, `country`). All address fields
arrived as `undefined`, breaking the partner widget prefill since v2.0.0.

### New `lookupSirene()` return type — `SireneLookupResult`

```typescript
import { ScellPublicClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_...');
const result = await client.onboarding.lookupSirene('10178342100015');

// result: SireneLookupResult
//   data: CompanyData | null
//   sirene_lookup_succeeded: boolean
//   manual_entry_required: boolean
//   code: string | null

if (result.data) {
  // Sirene found the company
  console.log(result.data.name);            // 'RL CONSEIL'
  console.log(result.data.legal_name);      // 'RL CONSEIL'
  console.log(result.data.address_line1);   // '200 RUE DE LA CROIX NIVERT'
  console.log(result.data.postal_code);     // '75015'
  console.log(result.data.city);            // 'PARIS'
  console.log(result.data.country);         // 'FR'
  console.log(result.data.vat_number);      // 'FR95101783421'
  console.log(result.data.legal_form);      // '5710'
  console.log(result.data.naf_code);        // '62.02A'
  console.log(result.data.creation_date);   // '2026-01-19'
  console.log(result.data.is_active);       // true
} else if (result.manual_entry_required) {
  // Etalab + INSEE both down -> show manual entry form
  // result.code === 'SIRENE_MANUAL_ENTRY_REQUIRED'
} else if (result.code === 'SIRENE_NOT_FOUND') {
  // SIRET unknown to the registry
}
```

### `CompanyData` interface (mirror of API shape)

```typescript
interface CompanyData {
  siret: string;
  siren: string;
  name: string;
  legal_name?: string | null;
  legal_form?: string | null;
  legal_form_code?: string | null;
  naf_code?: string | null;
  naf_label?: string | null;
  vat_number?: string | null;
  address_line1: string;          // <- flat (was nested before)
  address_line2?: string | null;
  postal_code: string;
  city: string;
  country: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  creation_date?: string | null;  // <- new
  employee_range?: string | null; // <- new
}
```

### Helper `parseSireneLookup(raw)`

For partners who proxy the endpoint server-side and want to reuse the
discriminant logic:

```typescript
import { parseSireneLookup } from '@scell/sdk';

const raw = await fetch('/api/proxy/sirene', { ... }).then(r => r.json());
const result = parseSireneLookup(raw);
```

### Migration from v2.2.0

```typescript
// BEFORE — never worked, address was always undefined
const { data, sirene_lookup_succeeded } =
  await client.onboarding.lookupSirene('10178342100015');
console.log(data?.address.line1); // undefined

// AFTER (v2.3.0+)
const result = await client.onboarding.lookupSirene('10178342100015');
console.log(result.data?.address_line1); // '200 RUE DE LA CROIX NIVERT'
```

The `SireneLookupResponse` type is kept as a `@deprecated` alias of
`SireneLookupResult` so `import { SireneLookupResponse }` still compiles.

---

## v2.2.0 (2026-05-10) — Billing Invoice Pay (Stripe)

Minor, additive release. Adds Stripe payment initiation for platform billing invoices.

### New method `client.billing.payInvoice()`

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient, type PaymentIntent, type SingleResponse } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_xxx');

const { data: pi }: SingleResponse<PaymentIntent> =
  await client.billing.payInvoice('billing-invoice-uuid');

// Pass client_secret to Stripe.js on the front-end
await stripe.confirmCardPayment(pi.client_secret, {
  payment_method: { card: cardElement },
});

console.log(pi.payment_intent_id); // pi_...
console.log(pi.amount);            // 4900 (cents)
console.log(pi.currency);          // "eur"
console.log(pi.status);            // "requires_payment_method"
```

**Errors**: `ScellNotFoundError` 404 (invoice belongs to another tenant) ·
`ScellValidationError` 422 (status not payable: draft, paid, cancelled).

**New type**: `PaymentIntent` — exported from `@scell/sdk`.
**Updated type**: `TenantInvoice` — new optional field `stripe_payment_intent_id?: string | null`.

---

## v2.1.0 (2026-05-08) — Tenant Invoice Download

Minor, additive release. Closes a gap where tenant API keys (`sk_live_*` /
`sk_test_*`) could not download Factur-X PDF / UBL XML / CII XML for
invoices created via `client.tenantInvoices.create(...)` or
`client.tenantInvoices.createForSubTenant(...)`.

### New methods on `client.tenantInvoices`

```typescript
import { ScellClient } from '@scell/sdk';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const client = new ScellClient({ apiKey: 'sk_live_xxx' });

// Download a tenant-direct invoice (Factur-X PDF/A-3 by default)
const pdfBuffer = await client.tenantInvoices.download('019d-uuid');
writeFileSync('invoice.pdf', Buffer.from(pdfBuffer));

// Pure XML (UBL or CII depending on the invoice's output_format)
const xmlBuffer = await client.tenantInvoices.download('019d-uuid', 'xml');

// Sub-tenant scoped (404 if invoice belongs to another sub-tenant — anti-IDOR)
const pdf = await client.tenantInvoices.downloadForSubTenant(
  'sub-tenant-uuid',
  'invoice-uuid',
);

// Format param: 'facturx' (default) | 'pdf' (alias) | 'xml'
```

Both methods return a `Promise<ArrayBuffer>` (binary). Wrap with
`Buffer.from(buffer)` in Node.js or `new Blob([buffer], { type })` in
the browser.

### Endpoints (backend)

- `GET /api/v1/tenant/invoices/{invoiceId}/download[?format=facturx|pdf|xml]`
- `GET /api/v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/download[?format=]`

Auth: `X-API-Key: sk_*` (server-side only, never publishable key).

---

## v2.0.0 (2026-05-08) — Breaking Changes

Major release. Aligns the SDK with the Scell.io API v2 onboarding model.
Backend requirement: Scell.io API v2.0+.

### What changed

- `SubTenant` no longer exposes `kyc_status`, `kyc_verified_at`, `kyc_delegated`.
- New required field `onboarding_status: OnboardingStatus` on `SubTenant`
  with 6 possible values.
- New SubTenant fields: `superpdp_company_verification_status`,
  `superpdp_user_identity_verification_status`, `last_polled_at`,
  `recommended_action`, `contact_first_name`, `contact_last_name`, `resume_url`.
- 5 new endpoints (Sirene lookup, widget create sub-tenant, SuperPDP
  status query/refresh, resume URL).

### Migration: `kyc_status` → `onboarding_status`

| Legacy `kyc_status` | New `onboarding_status`                                                                       |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `'pending'`         | `'pending_superpdp'`, `'superpdp_redirected'`, `'superpdp_authorized'`, `'superpdp_pending_review'` |
| `'verified'`        | `'active'`                                                                                    |
| `'rejected'`        | `'superpdp_failed'`                                                                           |

```typescript
// BEFORE (v1.x)
if (subTenant.kyc_status === 'verified') { /* onboarded */ }

// AFTER (v2.0)
if (subTenant.onboarding_status === 'active') { /* onboarded */ }
```

## Onboarding v2 — Widget endpoints (publishable-key auth)

```typescript
import { ScellPublicClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const publicClient = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_...');

// 1. Sirene lookup (prefill widget)
const lookup = await publicClient.onboarding.lookupSirene('12345678901234');
// { data: CompanyData | null, sirene_lookup_succeeded: boolean }

// 2. Create sub-tenant from widget data
const result = await publicClient.onboarding.createSubTenant({
  external_id: 'crm-42',
  company: lookup.data!,
  identity: { first_name: 'Marie', last_name: 'Dupont', email: 'marie@acme.fr' },
  locale: 'fr',
});
// result.data: SubTenant
// result.recommended_action: RecommendedAction | null  (FR/EN i18n)
// result.resume_url: string | null  (signed, valid 7 days)
```

## SubTenants SuperPDP status v2 — Bearer auth (master tenant)

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient, ScellRateLimitError } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_...');

// Cached status
const status = await client.subTenants.getSuperPDPStatus(subTenantId);
// status.data: SubTenant (onboarding_status + superpdp_*_verification_status)
// status.recommended_action: RecommendedAction | null

// Force fresh poll (rate-limited 1/min/sub-tenant)
try {
  const fresh = await client.subTenants.refreshSuperPDPStatus(subTenantId);
} catch (e) {
  if (e instanceof ScellRateLimitError) { /* backoff */ }
}

// Regenerate signed resume URL (valid 7 days)
const { resume_url, expires_at } = await client.subTenants.getResumeUrl(subTenantId);

// Disconnect SuperPDP (revoke tokens + reset onboarding_status to pending) — v3.1.0
await client.subTenants.superpdpDisconnect(subTenantId);

// Force a reconnect (disconnect + fresh authorize URL in one call) — v3.1.0
const { authorize_url, state } = await client.subTenants.superpdpReconnect(subTenantId);

// Mint a signed token for the <scell-onboarding mode="superpdp"> web component — v3.1.0
// { reset: true } disconnects before minting (force reconnect via the embedded widget).
const { resume_token } = await client.subTenants.superpdpWidgetToken(subTenantId, { reset: true });
```

## RecommendedAction (i18n FR/EN)

```typescript
interface RecommendedAction {
  code: string;
  severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'success';
  title_fr: string; title_en: string;
  message_fr: string; message_en: string;
  cta_label_fr: string; cta_label_en: string;
  cta_url: string | null;
  dismissible: boolean;
}
```

---


## Overview

Scell.io is a B2B micro-SaaS platform providing electronic invoicing (Factur-X/UBL/CII) and simple electronic signatures (eIDAS EU-SES) via API. This SDK provides full TypeScript support, zero external dependencies (uses native `fetch`), automatic retries with exponential backoff, webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and ESM/CommonJS dual module support. It works in Node.js 18+ and modern browsers.

Key capabilities:
- Create, submit, download French e-invoices (Factur-X, UBL, CII) for domestic and EU/international trade
- Create electronic signature requests (eIDAS EU-SES via OpenAPI.com)
- ISCA fiscal compliance: immutable chain, closings, FEC export, attestation, kill switch
- Multi-tenant architecture: sub-tenant provisioning, tenant invoice/credit note management
- SuperPDP OAuth2 Authorization Code onboarding flow (v1.11.0+, via `ScellPublicClient`)
- Webhook HMAC-SHA256 verification
- Automatic retry with exponential backoff + jitter

---

## Invoice & Credit Note Numbering

Numbers are **automatically generated** by Scell.io. Clients **NEVER** provide `invoice_number` or `credit_note_number` in creation payloads.

- **Draft invoices**: `DRAFT-{SLUG5}-{seq}` (e.g., `DRAFT-SCELL-00001`)
- **Submitted invoices**: `{SLUG5}-{YYYYMM}-{seq}` (e.g., `SCELL-202603-00001`)
- **Draft credit notes**: `DRAFT-CN-{SLUG5}-{seq}` (e.g., `DRAFT-CN-SCELL-00001`)
- **Sent credit notes**: `CN-{SLUG5}-{YYYYMM}-{seq}` (e.g., `CN-SCELL-202603-00001`)

Where `SLUG5` = first 5 characters of tenant slug (uppercase). Sequences reset monthly per tenant.

The number is assigned:
- At creation → temporary DRAFT number
- At `submit`/`send` → definitive fiscal number (immutable, ISCA-compliant)

Since v1.9.0, the backend generates invoice numbers automatically. Do **not** pass `invoice_number` to any create endpoint.

---

```bash
npm install @scell/sdk

yarn add @scell/sdk

```

```typescript
// Named imports (tree-shakeable)
import { ScellApiClient, ScellTenantClient, ScellPublicClient, ScellAuth, ScellWebhooks } from '@scell/sdk';

// CommonJS
const { ScellApiClient } = require('@scell/sdk');
```

## B2C Support — Private Individual Buyer

Since v1.14.0, Scell.io supports B2C invoices and credit notes where the
buyer is a private individual (no SIRET / SIREN / VAT / legal_id required).

### When to use B2C

| Buyer | Mode | `buyer_is_individual` |
|-------|------|----------------------|
| French company (FR) | B2B | `false` (default) |
| EU company (BE, DE, IT...) | B2B | `false` |
| Non-EU company (US, CN...) | B2B | `false` |
| Private individual (FR, EU, world) | **B2C** | `true` |

### Effects when `buyer_is_individual = true`

- **Server-side validation** : `buyer_siret`, `buyer_siren`, `buyer_vat_number`,
  `buyer_legal_id` are NOT required, even for `buyer_country = 'FR'`.
- **Factur-X / UBL / CII generation** : balises `BT-46` (BuyerLegalOrganisation),
  `BT-47` (BuyerTaxIdentifier), `BT-48` (BuyerVATIdentifier) are OMITTED.
  Only Name (BT-44) and Address (BG-8) of the buyer are included.
  Conformant with EN16931 BR-CO-26.
- **Payment terms** : the B2B legal mentions from French Code de commerce
  L441-10 (late payment penalties + recovery indemnity 40 EUR) are
  automatically suppressed.
- **Credit notes** : automatically inherit `buyer_is_individual` from
  the source invoice.

### Type definitions

```typescript
import type {
  CreateInvoiceInput,
  CreateTenantDirectInvoiceParams,
  TenantInvoiceBuyer,
  TenantInvoice,
} from '@scell/sdk';

// CreateInvoiceInput (ScellClient / ScellApiClient)
interface CreateInvoiceInput {
  // ... (existing fields)
  buyer_is_individual?: boolean | undefined;  // NEW v1.14.0
}

// TenantInvoiceBuyer (Tenant direct invoices)
interface TenantInvoiceBuyer {
  company_name: string;          // for B2C, use the full name
  siren?: Siren | undefined;     // optional
  siret?: Siret | undefined;     // optional, ignored if is_individual=true
  vat_number?: string | undefined;
  address: Address;
  email: string;
  is_individual?: boolean | undefined;  // NEW v1.14.0
}

// CreateTenantDirectInvoiceParams
interface CreateTenantDirectInvoiceParams {
  // ... (existing fields)
  buyer_is_individual?: boolean | undefined;  // NEW v1.14.0
                                               // alias for buyer.is_individual
}

// TenantInvoice (output)
interface TenantInvoice {
  // ... (existing fields)
  buyer: { ...; is_individual?: boolean };
  buyer_is_individual: boolean;  // NEW v1.14.0
}
```

### How to use

**ScellApiClient — server API** :
```typescript
const invoice = await api.invoices.create({
  direction: 'outgoing',
  output_format: 'facturx',
  issue_date: '2026-05-03',
  due_date: '2026-06-03',
  currency: 'EUR',
  total_ht: 150,
  total_tax: 30,
  total_ttc: 180,
  seller_siret: '12345678901234',
  seller_country: 'FR',
  seller_name: 'Coach Pro SAS',
  seller_address: { line1: '...', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
  // No buyer_siret needed for B2C
  buyer_country: 'FR',
  buyer_name: 'Marie Dupont',
  buyer_address: { line1: '12 rue de Rivoli', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
  buyer_is_individual: true,  // <-- B2C
  lines: [{ description: 'Coaching', quantity: 1, unit_price: 150, tax_rate: 20, total_ht: 150, total_tax: 30, total_ttc: 180 }],
});
```

**ScellTenantClient — tenant direct invoice** :
```typescript
const invoice = await tenant.tenantDirectInvoices.create({
  company_id: companyId,
  buyer: {
    company_name: 'Marie Dupont',  // full name for individuals
    address: { line1: '12 rue de Rivoli', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
    email: 'marie@example.com',
    is_individual: true,  // <-- B2C
  },
  lines: [{ description: 'Coaching', quantity: 1, unit_price: 150, tax_rate: 20, total_ht: 150, total_tax: 30, total_ttc: 180 }],
  issue_date: '2026-05-03',
});
```

### Inspect B2C status on existing invoice

```typescript
const invoice = await tenant.tenantDirectInvoices.get(id);
if (invoice.buyer_is_individual) {
  console.log('Particulier');
} else {
  console.log('Entreprise', invoice.buyer.siret);
}
```

### Migrating existing B2B code

No breaking change. All existing calls keep working — `buyer_is_individual`
defaults to `false`. Set the flag explicitly only for individual buyers.

## Invoice Templates — Personnalisation factures / avoirs (since v1.15.0)

Personnalisation visuelle (logo, couleurs, mentions) avec resolution cascade cote serveur.

### Cascade de resolution

1. `invoice.invoice_template_id` explicit
2. Default sub-tenant template
3. Default tenant template (avec `is_available_to_subtenants=true` si invoice via sub-tenant)
4. Default system template (Scell)

### Types

```typescript
import type {
  InvoiceTemplate,
  CreateInvoiceTemplateInput,
  UpdateInvoiceTemplateInput,
  InvoiceTemplateScope,         // 'system' | 'tenant' | 'sub_tenant'
  InvoiceTemplateLogoPosition,  // 'top-left' | 'top-center' | 'top-right'
} from '@scell/sdk';
```

### Resource `client.invoiceTemplates`

```typescript
// Lister
const page = await client.invoiceTemplates.list({ scope: 'tenant', per_page: 25 });

// Recuperer
const tpl = await client.invoiceTemplates.get(id);

// Creer
const tpl = await client.invoiceTemplates.create({
  scope: 'tenant',
  name: 'Brand Q4 2026',
  logo_url: 'https://cdn.client.com/logo.svg',
  primary_color: '#0F172A',
  accent_color: '#F472B6',
  custom_mentions: 'TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI',
  is_default: true,
  is_available_to_subtenants: true,
});

// Modifier
await client.invoiceTemplates.update(id, { name: 'Renamed' });

// Marquer default
await client.invoiceTemplates.markDefault(id);

// Supprimer (soft delete)
await client.invoiceTemplates.delete(id);
```

### Utiliser un template explicit

```typescript
const invoice = await api.invoices.create({
  // ... champs facture
  invoice_template_id: tpl.id,
});

// Avoir : herite du template de la facture, override possible
const cn = await tenant.tenantDirectCreditNotes.create({
  invoice_id: invoiceId,
  reason: 'Erreur de facturation',
  type: 'total',
  invoice_template_id: anotherTplId, // optional override
});
```

### Permissions

| Action | system | tenant own | sub-tenant own | tenant available_to_subtenants | other |
|--------|--------|------------|----------------|--------------------------------|-------|
| view | OK | OK | OK | OK (read) | 403 |
| create/update/delete | 403 | OK | OK | 403 | 403 |

## Daily Closure — Cloture quotidienne automatique

Chaque jour a 00:05 UTC, un cron Laravel execute pour chaque tenant actif :
1. Creation `FiscalClosing` (avec hash ISCA chaine).
2. Generation CSV format de marche : `increment_id, type, saving_date, document_date, total_excl_tax`.
3. Stockage CSV sur S3.
4. Envoi email avec recap chiffre + lien signe (5 jours validite).

### Format email (corps)

- Type de cloture : Journaliere
- Du / Au : periode UTC
- Nombre de documents
- Total HT / TVA
- Empreinte du block (hash ISCA)
- Empreinte du fichier (hash CSV)
- Bouton : "Telecharger votre cloture au format CSV"

### Type DailyClosure

```typescript
interface DailyClosure {
  id: UUID;
  tenant_id: UUID;
  closing_date: DateString;
  closing_type: 'daily' | 'monthly' | 'annual';
  entries_count: number;
  total_ht: number;
  total_tax: number;
  total_ttc: number;
  currency: string;
  closing_hash: string;
  csv_hash: string | null;
  csv_path: string | null;
  csv_url?: string;            // signed URL valid 5 days
  emailed_at: DateTimeString | null;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
}
```

### Recuperer via API

```typescript
const closings = await api.fiscal.listClosings({ from: '2026-05-01', to: '2026-05-03' });
const closing = await api.fiscal.getClosing(id);
// closing.csv_url est une signed URL valable 5 jours
```

---

## Authentication & Client Selection

There are **four** client classes, each using a different authentication mode:

| Client | Auth Header | Key Prefix | Use Case |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ScellClient` | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | N/A (login token) | Dashboard/user operations |
| `ScellApiClient` | `X-API-Key: <key>` | `sk_live_*` / `sk_test_*` | Server-to-server API (invoices, signatures) |
| `ScellTenantClient` | `X-Tenant-Key: <key>` | `tk_live_*` / `tk_test_*` | Multi-tenant partner operations |
| `ScellPublicClient` | `X-Publishable-Key: <key>` | `pk_live_*` / `pk_test_*` | Client-side onboarding widget |

**Sandbox mode**: use `sk_test_*` / `pk_test_*` keys. The backend automatically routes to the sandbox database. No separate base URL needed.

### ScellClient (Bearer Token)

Use for dashboard/user operations after logging in.

```typescript
import { ScellClient, ScellAuth } from '@scell/sdk';

const auth = await ScellAuth.login({ email: 'user@example.com', password: 'secret' });
const client = new ScellClient(auth.token);
```

Available resources: `auth`, `companies`, `apiKeys`, `balance`, `webhooks`, `invoices` (read-only), `signatures` (read-only), `creditNotes`

### ScellApiClient (API Key)

Use for server-to-server integrations. Create and manage invoices, signatures, sub-tenants.

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_xxx');
// Sandbox:
const sandboxClient = new ScellApiClient('sk_test_xxx');
```

Available resources: `invoices`, `signatures`, `subTenants`, `fiscal`, `stats`, `billing`, `creditNotes` (TenantCreditNotes), `tenantInvoices`, `tenantSignatures` (read-only, URL-nested), `incomingInvoices`, `onboarding`

### ScellTenantClient (Tenant Key)

Use for multi-tenant partner platforms. Manage invoices and credit notes on behalf of a provisioned tenant.

```typescript
import { ScellTenantClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellTenantClient('tk_live_xxx');
```

Available resources: `directInvoices`, `directCreditNotes`, `incomingInvoices`, `subTenantCreditNotes`, `fiscal`, `billing`, `stats`, `subTenants`

Direct methods (no sub-resource): `me()`, `updateProfile()`, `balance()`, `quickStats()`, `regenerateKey()`

### ScellPublicClient (Publishable Key)

Use in client-side code (browser/React/Vue) for the onboarding widget. Safe to expose publicly.

```typescript
import { ScellPublicClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_xxx');
// or sandbox:
const client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_test_xxx');
```

Available resources: `onboarding`

---

## Client Configuration

All four constructors accept an optional `ClientConfig` as the second argument:

```typescript
interface ClientConfig {
  baseUrl?: string;       // default: 'https://api.scell.io/api/v1'
  timeout?: number;       // ms, default: 30000
  retry?: RetryOptions;
  enableRetry?: boolean;  // default: true
  fetch?: typeof fetch;   // custom fetch implementation
}

interface RetryOptions {
  maxRetries?: number;    // default: 3
  initialDelay?: number;  // ms, default: 500
  maxDelay?: number;      // ms, default: 10000
  backoffMultiplier?: number; // default: 2
  jitter?: boolean;       // default: true
}
```

**Per-request options** (`RequestOptions`):

```typescript
interface RequestOptions {
  timeout?: number;       // override timeout for this request
  skipRetry?: boolean;    // disable retry for this request
  headers?: Record<string, string>; // extra headers
  signal?: AbortSignal;   // abort controller signal
}
```

Example with full config:

```typescript
const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_xxx', {
  timeout: 60000,
  retry: {
    maxRetries: 5,
    initialDelay: 1000,
    maxDelay: 30000,
    backoffMultiplier: 2,
    jitter: true,
  },
});
```

## Response Shapes

All methods return typed responses:

```typescript
// Paginated list
interface PaginatedResponse<T> {
  data: T[];
  meta: PaginationMeta;
}

interface PaginationMeta {
  current_page: number;
  last_page: number;
  per_page: number;
  total: number;
  from: number | null;
  to: number | null;
}

// Single resource
interface SingleResponse<T> {
  data: T;
}

// Message only
interface MessageResponse {
  message: string;
}

// Message + data
interface MessageWithDataResponse<T> {
  message: string;
  data: T;
}
```

## Error Handling

All API errors throw typed error classes that extend `ScellError`:

```typescript
import {
  ScellError,
  ScellAuthenticationError,   // 401
  ScellAuthorizationError,    // 403
  ScellValidationError,       // 422
  ScellRateLimitError,        // 429
  ScellNotFoundError,         // 404
  ScellServerError,           // 500
  ScellInsufficientBalanceError, // 402 (insufficient balance)
  ScellNetworkError,          // Network failure
  ScellTimeoutError,          // Request timeout
} from '@scell/sdk';

try {
  const invoice = await client.invoices.create({ ... });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ScellValidationError) {
    console.error('Validation errors:', error.errors);
    // error.errors: Record<string, string[]>
  } else if (error instanceof ScellInsufficientBalanceError) {
    console.error('Insufficient balance. Please top up.');
    // error.balance?: number
    // error.required?: number
  } else if (error instanceof ScellRateLimitError) {
    console.error('Rate limited. Retry after:', error.retryAfter);
    // error.retryAfter?: number (seconds)
  } else if (error instanceof ScellAuthenticationError) {
    console.error('Invalid or expired token/API key');
  } else if (error instanceof ScellAuthorizationError) {
    console.error('Forbidden — insufficient permissions');
  } else if (error instanceof ScellNotFoundError) {
    console.error('Resource not found:', error.message);
  } else if (error instanceof ScellServerError) {
    console.error('Server error:', error.statusCode, error.message);
  } else if (error instanceof ScellNetworkError) {
    console.error('Network failure:', error.cause);
  } else if (error instanceof ScellTimeoutError) {
    console.error('Request timed out');
  } else if (error instanceof ScellError) {
    console.error('API error:', error.statusCode, error.message);
  }
}
```

### `ScellError` base class properties

```typescript
class ScellError extends Error {
  statusCode: number;
  message: string;
  originalError?: unknown;
}

class ScellValidationError extends ScellError {
  errors: Record<string, string[]>; // field-level validation errors
}

class ScellRateLimitError extends ScellError {
  retryAfter?: number; // seconds until retry is allowed
}

class ScellInsufficientBalanceError extends ScellError {
  balance?: number;    // current balance in euros
  required?: number;   // required amount in euros
}

class ScellNetworkError extends ScellError {
  cause?: Error;       // underlying network error
}
```

## Invoice Types

```typescript
type InvoiceDirection = 'outgoing' | 'incoming';
type InvoiceFormat = 'facturx' | 'ubl' | 'cii' | 'en16931';
type InvoiceStatus =
  | 'draft'
  | 'pending'
  | 'validated'
  | 'rejected'
  | 'cancelled'
  | 'processing'
  | 'error'
  | 'paid'
  | 'disputed'
  | 'accepted'
  | 'pending_payment';

type InvoiceDownloadType = 'pdf' | 'xml' | 'facturx' | 'ubl' | 'cii';
type InvoiceFileFormat = 'pdf' | 'xml';

interface InvoiceLine {
  id: UUID;
  description: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit_price: number;
  tax_rate: number;
  total_ht: number;
  total_tax: number;
  total_ttc: number;
  unit?: string;
  product_code?: string;
}

interface InvoiceLineInput {
  description: string;
  quantity: number;
  unit_price: number;
  tax_rate: number;
  total_ht: number;
  total_tax: number;
  total_ttc: number;
  unit?: string;
  product_code?: string;
}

interface InvoiceParty {
  siret?: string;
  siren?: string;
  vat_number?: string;
  name: string;
  address: Address;
  email?: string;
  phone?: string;
}

interface Invoice {
  id: UUID;
  invoice_number: string;   // server-generated, never passed in create
  direction: InvoiceDirection;
  output_format: InvoiceFormat;
  status: InvoiceStatus;
  issue_date: DateString;
  due_date?: DateString;
  currency: CurrencyCode;
  total_ht: number;
  total_tax: number;
  total_ttc: number;
  seller: InvoiceParty;
  buyer: InvoiceParty;
  lines: InvoiceLine[];
  notes?: string;
  payment_reference?: string;
  paid_at?: DateTimeString;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  updated_at: DateTimeString;
}

// IMPORTANT: Do NOT include invoice_number — it is server-generated
interface CreateInvoiceInput {
  direction: InvoiceDirection;
  output_format: InvoiceFormat;
  issue_date: DateString;
  due_date?: DateString;
  currency?: CurrencyCode;    // default: 'EUR'
  total_ht: number;
  total_tax: number;
  total_ttc: number;
  // French/domestic seller
  seller_siret: Siret;
  seller_name: string;
  seller_address: Address;
  seller_email?: string;
  seller_vat_number?: string;
  // French/domestic buyer (use one of: siret, vat_number, or legal_id)
  buyer_siret?: Siret;
  buyer_name: string;
  buyer_address: Address;
  buyer_email?: string;
  // EU buyer (non-FR): use VAT number
  buyer_vat_number?: string;
  // Non-EU international buyer: use legal_id + scheme
  buyer_legal_id?: string;
  buyer_legal_id_scheme?: string; // e.g. 'DUNS', 'GLN', 'LEI'
  lines: InvoiceLineInput[];
  notes?: string;
  payment_terms?: string;
}

interface InvoiceListOptions extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {
  direction?: InvoiceDirection;
  status?: InvoiceStatus;
  search?: string;
}

interface IncomingInvoiceParams extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {
  status?: InvoiceStatus;
  seller_siret?: string;
}

interface ConvertInvoiceInput {
  invoice_id: UUID;
  target_format: InvoiceFormat;
}

interface AuditTrailEntry {
  id: UUID;
  action: string;
  actor_type: string;
  actor_id?: UUID;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface AuditTrailResponse {
  data: AuditTrailEntry[];
  integrity_valid: boolean;
}

// Incoming invoice lifecycle actions
type RejectionCode =
  | 'incorrect_amount'
  | 'incorrect_vat'
  | 'incorrect_dates'
  | 'missing_information'
  | 'duplicate_invoice'
  | 'not_ordered'
  | 'other';

type DisputeType =
  | 'amount_dispute'
  | 'quality_dispute'
  | 'delivery_dispute'
  | 'other';

interface AcceptInvoiceInput {
  payment_date?: DateString;
  note?: string;
}

interface RejectInvoiceInput {
  reason: string;
  reason_code?: RejectionCode;
}

interface DisputeInvoiceInput {
  reason: string;
  dispute_type?: DisputeType;
  expected_amount?: number;
}

interface MarkPaidInput {
  payment_reference?: string;
  paid_at?: DateTimeString;
  note?: string;
}

interface InvoiceDownloadResponse {
  url: string;
  expires_at: DateTimeString;
}
```

## Signature Types

```typescript
type SignerAuthMethod = 'email' | 'sms' | 'none';
type SignerStatus = 'pending' | 'signed' | 'rejected' | 'bounced';
type SignatureStatus = 'draft' | 'pending' | 'completed' | 'rejected' | 'cancelled' | 'expired';
type SignatureDownloadType = 'pdf' | 'audit_trail';

interface SignaturePosition {
  page: number;
  x: number;                      // unit defined by `unit`
  y: number;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  unit?: 'percent' | 'pixel';     // default: 'percent' (0-100)
  page_width_px?: number;         // optional, fallback A4 (595) if absent
  page_height_px?: number;        // optional, fallback A4 (842) if absent
}

// SignatureUIConfig: 21 champs conformes OpenAPI.com EU-SES v1.0.17
interface SignatureUIConfig {
  // Sidebar
  sidebar_logo?: string;
  sidebar_background_color?: string;
  sidebar_title_color?: string;
  sidebar_text_color?: string;
  // Header
  header_background_color?: string;
  header_title_color?: string;
  header_subtitle_color?: string;
  // Footer
  footer_background_color?: string;
  // Boutons standards
  button_text_color?: string;
  button_text_color_hover?: string;
  button_background_color?: string;
  button_background_color_hover?: string;
  // Bouton "Signer"
  sign_button_text_color?: string;
  sign_button_text_color_hover?: string;
  sign_button_background_color?: string;
  sign_button_background_color_hover?: string;
  // Toggles d'affichage
  hide_sidebar?: boolean;
  hide_header?: boolean;
  hide_download_validated?: boolean;
  hide_download_signed?: boolean;
  // Iframe (max 20 URLs)
  iframe_ancestors?: string[];
}

interface SignatureOptions {
  signature_mode?: 'typed' | 'drawn' | 'both';
  signer_must_read?: boolean;
  user_editable_data?: { name?: boolean; mobile?: boolean; email?: boolean };
  timezone?: string;              // IANA, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'
}

interface Signer {
  id: UUID;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone?: string;
  auth_method: SignerAuthMethod;
  status: SignerStatus;
  signed_at?: DateTimeString;
  rejected_at?: DateTimeString;
  rejection_reason?: string;
}

interface Signature {
  id: UUID;
  title: string;
  status: SignatureStatus;
  document_name: string;
  signers: Signer[];
  message?: string;
  ui_config?: SignatureUIConfig;
  expires_at?: DateTimeString;
  completed_at?: DateTimeString;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  updated_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface SignerInput {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  phone?: string;
  auth_method?: SignerAuthMethod; // default: 'email'
  position?: SignaturePosition;
  message?: string;                // max 500 chars, supports {OTP} placeholder
}

interface CreateSignatureInput {
  title: string;
  document: string;      // base64-encoded PDF content
  document_name: string; // filename with .pdf extension
  signers: SignerInput[];
  message?: string;
  ui_config?: SignatureUIConfig;
  signature_options?: SignatureOptions;
  expires_at?: DateTimeString;
}

interface SignatureListOptions {
  company_id?: UUID;
  sub_tenant_id?: UUID;
  status?: SignatureStatus;
  environment?: Environment;
  /** Max 100. */
  per_page?: number;
}

interface SignatureDownloadResponse {
  url: string;
  expires_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface SignatureRemindResponse {
  message: string;
  reminded_count: number;
}
```

```typescript
type WebhookEvent =
  | 'invoice.created'
  | 'invoice.updated'
  | 'invoice.submitted'
  | 'invoice.validated'
  | 'invoice.rejected'
  | 'invoice.cancelled'
  | 'invoice.paid'
  | 'invoice.disputed'
  | 'invoice.accepted'
  | 'invoice.incoming.received'
  | 'invoice.incoming.paid'
  | 'signature.created'
  | 'signature.completed'
  | 'signature.rejected'
  | 'signature.cancelled'
  | 'signature.expired'
  | 'signature.signer.signed'
  | 'signature.signer.rejected'
  | 'balance.updated'
  | 'balance.low'
  | 'balance.reloaded';

interface Webhook {
  id: UUID;
  url: string;
  events: WebhookEvent[];
  is_active: boolean;
  description?: string;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  updated_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface WebhookWithSecret extends Webhook {
  secret: string;  // shown only on creation; store it securely
}

interface CreateWebhookInput {
  url: string;
  events: WebhookEvent[];
  description?: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

interface UpdateWebhookInput {
  url?: string;
  events?: WebhookEvent[];
  description?: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

  is_active?: boolean;
}

  message: string;
  status_code: number;
  response_time_ms: number;
}

interface WebhookLog {
  id: UUID;
  webhook_id: UUID;
  event: WebhookEvent;
  status_code: number;
  response_time_ms: number;
  success: boolean;
  request_payload?: unknown;
  response_body?: string;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface WebhookPayload<T = unknown> {
  id: string;
  event: WebhookEvent;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  data: T;
}

interface InvoiceWebhookData {
  invoice: Invoice;
}

  signature: Signature;
}

interface BalanceWebhookData {
  balance: number;

}

  paid_at: DateTimeString;
}
```

## Fiscal Types (ISCA Compliance)

```typescript
type FiscalComplianceStatus = 'compliant' | 'warning' | 'non_compliant';
type FiscalAttestationStatus = 'pending' | 'valid' | 'failed';
type FiscalKillSwitchStatus = 'active' | 'inactive';
type FiscalRuleCategory = 'invoice' | 'signature' | 'general';
type FiscalForensicExportType = 'full' | 'incremental';

interface FiscalComplianceData {
  status: FiscalComplianceStatus;
  last_check: DateTimeString;
  issues: FiscalIncident[];
  chain_integrity: boolean;
  last_closing?: DateString;
}

interface FiscalIncident {
  id: UUID;
  type: string;
  severity: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'critical';
  description: string;
  detected_at: DateTimeString;
  resolved_at?: DateTimeString;
  resolved: boolean;
}

interface FiscalAttestation {
  id: UUID;
  status: FiscalAttestationStatus;
  period_start: DateString;
  period_end: DateString;
  generated_at?: DateTimeString;
  pdf_url?: string;
  expires_at?: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalClosingTotals {
  invoices_count?: number;
  invoices_total_ht?: number;
  invoices_total_ttc?: number;
  invoices_total_tax?: number;
  credit_notes_count?: number;
  credit_notes_total?: number;
  total_entries?: number;
}

interface FiscalClosingOtsCalendar {
  calendar: string;     // e.g. https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org
  ok: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
}

interface FiscalClosing {
  id: UUID;
  tenant_id: UUID;
  sub_tenant_id?: UUID | null;      // null for master tenant's own flows
  closing_date: DateString;
  closing_type: 'daily' | 'monthly' | 'annual';
  status: 'closed' | 'anchored';
  entries_count: number;

  // Legacy / derived (pre-2.10.0 payloads)
  total_debit?: number;
  total_credit?: number;
  chain_hash?: string;              // alias of closing_hash

  // Sequence + chain hash (ISCA)
  first_sequence_number?: number;
  last_sequence_number?: number;
  closing_hash?: string;            // SHA-256
  previous_closing_hash?: string | null;

  totals?: FiscalClosingTotals;
  cumulative_totals?: Record<string, number>;
  environment?: 'sandbox' | 'production';

  csv_path?: string | null;         // S3 path of the daily-closure CSV
  csv_hash?: string | null;

  // OpenTimestamps Bitcoin anchoring (since v2.10.0)
  // Raw BYTEA proof is NOT exposed (non-UTF8); base64-encoded instead.
  ots_proof_base64?: string | null;
  ots_status?: 'pending' | 'bitcoin_confirmed' | 'failed' | null;
  ots_submitted_at?: DateTimeString | null;
  ots_bitcoin_confirmed_at?: DateTimeString | null;
  ots_calendars?: FiscalClosingOtsCalendar[] | null;

  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  created_at?: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalEntry {
  id: UUID;
  type: string;
  reference_id: UUID;
  reference_type: string;
  amount: number;
  hash: string;
  previous_hash?: string;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalIntegrityCheck {
  id: UUID;
  period_start: DateString;
  period_end: DateString;
  passed: boolean;
  issues_found: number;
  checked_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalIntegrityReport {
  overall_status: FiscalComplianceStatus;
  checks: FiscalIntegrityCheck[];
  entries_checked: number;
  closings_checked: number;
  chain_valid: boolean;
}

interface FiscalKillSwitch {
  id: UUID;
  status: FiscalKillSwitchStatus;
  activated_at?: DateTimeString;
  activated_by?: string;
  reason?: string;
}

interface FiscalKillSwitchActivateInput {
  reason: string;
}

interface FiscalAnchor {
  id: UUID;
  hash: string;
  tsa_timestamp?: string;
  tsa_response?: string;
  anchored_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalRule {
  id: UUID;
  category: FiscalRuleCategory;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  created_at: DateTimeString;
  updated_at: DateTimeString;
}

interface FiscalCreateRuleInput {
  category: FiscalRuleCategory;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

interface FiscalUpdateRuleInput {
  name?: string;
  description?: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

interface FiscalReplayRulesInput {
  from_date?: DateString;
  to_date?: DateString;
}

interface FiscalDailyClosingInput {
  date?: DateString;  // default: today
}

interface FiscalFecExportOptions {
  year: number;
  month?: number;
  format?: 'csv' | 'txt';
}

interface FiscalFecExportResult {
  url: string;
  expires_at: DateTimeString;
  entries_count: number;
}

interface FiscalForensicExportOptions {
  type?: FiscalForensicExportType;
  from_date?: DateString;
  to_date?: DateString;
}

interface FiscalEntriesOptions extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {
  type?: string;
}

interface FiscalClosingsOptions extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {
  type?: 'daily' | 'monthly';
}

interface FiscalAnchorsOptions extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {}

interface FiscalIntegrityOptions {
  from_date?: DateString;
  to_date?: DateString;
}

interface FiscalIntegrityHistoryOptions extends PaginationOptions, DateRangeOptions {}

interface FiscalRulesOptions extends PaginationOptions {
  category?: FiscalRuleCategory;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

interface FiscalExportRulesOptions {
  format?: 'json' | 'csv';
}
```

## ScellClient — Dashboard Operations

`new ScellClient(token: string, config?: ClientConfig)`

### `client.auth`

```typescript
// Get current authenticated user
const user: User = await client.auth.me();

// Logout (revokes token)
await client.auth.logout();
```

### `client.companies`

```typescript
// List companies
const { data, meta } = await client.companies.list({ page: 1, per_page: 20 });

// Get company
const { data: company } = await client.companies.get('company-uuid');

// Create company
const { data: company } = await client.companies.create({
  name: 'Acme SARL',
  siret: '12345678901234',
  address: { line1: '1 Rue Exemple', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
});

// Update company
const { data: company } = await client.companies.update('company-uuid', { email: 'new@example.com' });

// Delete company
await client.companies.delete('company-uuid');

// Initiate KYC verification
const { kyc_url, expires_at } = await client.companies.initiateKyc('company-uuid');

// Check KYC status
const { status, kyc_verified } = await client.companies.kycStatus('company-uuid');
```

## ScellAuth — Static Auth Methods

```typescript
import { ScellAuth } from '@scell/sdk';

// Login
const { token, user }: AuthResponse = await ScellAuth.login({
  email: 'user@example.com',
  password: 'password',
});

// Register
const { token, user }: AuthResponse = await ScellAuth.register({
  name: 'Alice Dupont',
  email: 'alice@example.com',
  password: 'secret123',
  password_confirmation: 'secret123',
});

// Forgot password
await ScellAuth.forgotPassword({ email: 'user@example.com' });

// Reset password
await ScellAuth.resetPassword({
  token: 'reset-token-from-email',
  email: 'user@example.com',
  password: 'newpassword',
  password_confirmation: 'newpassword',
});
```

### `client.invoices` (InvoicesResource — full CRUD)

```typescript
// List
const { data, meta } = await client.invoices.list({
  direction: 'outgoing',
  status: 'validated',
  date_from: '2026-01-01',
  date_to: '2026-03-31',
  per_page: 50,
});

// Get
const { data: invoice } = await client.invoices.get('invoice-uuid');

// Create (server generates invoice_number — do NOT pass it)
const { data: invoice } = await client.invoices.create({
  direction: 'outgoing',
  output_format: 'facturx',
  issue_date: '2026-03-15',
  due_date: '2026-04-15',
  currency: 'EUR',
  total_ht: 1000.00,
  total_tax: 200.00,
  total_ttc: 1200.00,
  seller_siret: '12345678901234',
  seller_name: 'My Company SAS',
  seller_address: { line1: '1 Rue de la Paix', postal_code: '75001', city: 'Paris', country: 'FR' },
  buyer_siret: '98765432109876',
  buyer_name: 'Client Corp SARL',
  buyer_address: { line1: '2 Avenue des Champs', postal_code: '69001', city: 'Lyon', country: 'FR' },
  lines: [{
    description: 'Software development services',
    quantity: 10,
    unit_price: 100.00,
    tax_rate: 20,
    total_ht: 1000.00,
    total_tax: 200.00,
    total_ttc: 1200.00,
  }],
});
console.log('Invoice:', invoice.invoice_number, invoice.status); // 'DRAFT-XXXXX-00001', 'draft'

// Submit for processing
await client.invoices.submit('invoice-uuid');

// Download (returns temporary URL)
const { url, expires_at } = await client.invoices.download('invoice-uuid', 'pdf');

// Download file as binary (ArrayBuffer)
const pdfBuffer = await client.invoices.downloadFile('invoice-uuid', 'pdf');
const xmlBuffer = await client.invoices.downloadFile('invoice-uuid', 'xml');

// Audit trail
const { data: entries, integrity_valid } = await client.invoices.auditTrail('invoice-uuid');

// Convert to another format
await client.invoices.convert({ invoice_id: 'invoice-uuid', target_format: 'ubl' });

// List incoming invoices (as buyer)
const { data } = await client.invoices.incoming({ status: 'pending', per_page: 50 });

// Accept incoming invoice
await client.invoices.accept('invoice-uuid', { payment_date: '2026-04-15', note: 'Approved' });

// Reject incoming invoice
await client.invoices.reject('invoice-uuid', { reason: 'Wrong amount', reason_code: 'incorrect_amount' });

// Dispute incoming invoice
await client.invoices.dispute('invoice-uuid', {
  reason: 'Amount exceeds agreed price',
  dispute_type: 'amount_dispute',
  expected_amount: 950.00,
});

// Mark as paid
await client.invoices.markPaid('invoice-uuid', {
  payment_reference: 'VIR-2026-0124',
  paid_at: '2026-01-24T10:30:00Z',
  note: 'Bank transfer received',
});
```

### `client.signatures` (SignaturesResource)

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

// List
const { data, meta } = await client.signatures.list({ status: 'pending', per_page: 20 });

// Get
const { data: sig } = await client.signatures.get('sig-uuid');

// Create
const pdfBase64 = readFileSync('contract.pdf').toString('base64');
const { data: sig } = await client.signatures.create({
  title: 'Service Agreement Q1 2026',
  document: pdfBase64,
  document_name: 'service-agreement.pdf',
  message: 'Please sign this agreement before starting.',
  signers: [
    {
      name: 'Alice Martin',
      email: 'alice@client.com',
      auth_method: 'email',
      position: { page: 1, x: 50, y: 200, width: 100, height: 30 },
    },
  ],
  ui_config: {
    sidebar_logo: 'https://mycompany.com/logo.png',
    sidebar_background_color: '#2563EB',
    sign_button_background_color: '#10B981',
    hide_download_validated: false,
    iframe_ancestors: ['https://app.mycompany.com'],
  },
  signature_options: {
    signature_mode: 'both',
    signer_must_read: true,
    timezone: 'Europe/Paris',
  },
});

// Check status (poll until completed/rejected)
const { data: sig } = await client.signatures.get(sig.id);
console.log(sig.status); // 'pending' | 'completed' | 'rejected'
sig.signers.forEach(s => console.log(s.email, s.status)); // individual signer statuses

// Download signed document
const { url } = await client.signatures.download('sig-uuid', 'pdf');

// Download audit trail
const { url: auditUrl } = await client.signatures.download('sig-uuid', 'audit_trail');

// Get audit trail (structured data)
const { data: entries } = await client.signatures.auditTrail('sig-uuid');

// Send reminder to pending signers
const { reminded_count } = await client.signatures.remind('sig-uuid');
console.log('Reminded', reminded_count, 'signers');

// Cancel
await client.signatures.cancel('sig-uuid');
```

### `client.tenantSignatures` (TenantSignaturesResource — read-only, URL-nested)

Available on `ScellApiClient` (as `tenantSignatures`) and on
`ScellTenantClient` (as `signatures`). Read-only access to signatures
scoped strictly to the authenticated tenant via `X-API-Key`. Anti-IDOR
is enforced server-side : passing an arbitrary sub-tenant or signature
UUID that does not belong to the tenant returns 404.

```typescript
// List all signatures of the tenant
const { data, meta } = await client.tenantSignatures.list({
  status: 'completed',
  environment: 'production',
  per_page: 50,
});

// Get a single signature
const { data: sig } = await client.tenantSignatures.get('sig-uuid');

// Sub-tenant scoped (URL-nested, no sub_tenant_id query param)
const { data: subSigs } = await client.tenantSignatures.listForSubTenant(
  'sub-tenant-uuid',
  { status: 'pending' },
);

const { data: subSig } = await client.tenantSignatures.getForSubTenant(
  'sub-tenant-uuid',
  'sig-uuid',
);
```

Endpoints :
- `GET /v1/tenant/signatures`
- `GET /v1/tenant/signatures/{id}`
- `GET /v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/signatures`
- `GET /v1/tenant/sub-tenants/{subTenantId}/signatures/{id}`

Filter options (`TenantSignatureListOptions`) : `status`
(`pending` | `completed` | `refused` | `expired`), `environment`
(`sandbox` | `production`), `per_page` (max 100).

## ScellPublicClient — Onboarding Widget

`new ScellPublicClient(publishableKey: string, config?: ClientConfig)`

The `ScellPublicClient` is designed for browser/client-side use. Only exposes the `onboarding` resource.

### Full SuperPDP OAuth2 Onboarding Flow

```typescript
// --- STEP 1: Create session (call from your frontend) ---
import { ScellPublicClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_xxx');
const { data: session } = await client.onboarding.createSession();
// session.id, session.step ('connect'), session.expires_at

// --- STEP 2: Get SuperPDP authorize URL ---
const { authorize_url, state } = await client.onboarding.getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl(session.id);
// Store `state` to verify later (CSRF protection)
sessionStorage.setItem('scell_oauth_state', state);
sessionStorage.setItem('scell_session_id', session.id);

// --- STEP 3: Open popup ---
const popup = window.open(
  authorize_url,
  'scell-onboarding',
  'width=800,height=700,left=200,top=100'
);

// --- STEP 4: Listen for callback message from popup ---
window.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
  if (event.origin !== 'https://app.mycompany.com') return;
  const { code, state: returnedState } = event.data;

  // Verify state matches (CSRF protection)
  const savedState = sessionStorage.getItem('scell_oauth_state');
  if (returnedState !== savedState) {
    console.error('State mismatch — possible CSRF attack');
    return;
  }

  const sessionId = sessionStorage.getItem('scell_session_id');

  // --- STEP 5: Complete callback ---
  const result = await client.onboarding.superpdpCallback(sessionId, code, returnedState);
  if (result.success) {
    console.log('Onboarding complete! Tenant:', result.tenant.name);
    // Send tenant credentials to YOUR backend for storage
    await fetch('/api/tenants', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ tenant: result.tenant }),
    });
  }
});
```

### `OnboardingResource` methods

```typescript
// Create a new onboarding session
const { data: session }: SingleResponse<OnboardingSession> =
  await client.onboarding.createSession();

// Get session status
const { data: session }: SingleResponse<OnboardingSession> =
  await client.onboarding.getSession(sessionId);
// session.step: 'connect' | 'redirect' | 'complete'

// Get SuperPDP authorize URL
const response: SuperPDPAuthorizeResponse =
  await client.onboarding.getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl(sessionId);
// { authorize_url: string, state: string }

// Complete OAuth2 callback
const response: SuperPDPCallbackResponse =
  await client.onboarding.superpdpCallback(sessionId, code, state);
// { success: boolean, tenant: SuperPDPCallbackTenant, session: OnboardingSession }
```

---

## Fiscal Compliance (ISCA)

Available on both `ScellApiClient.fiscal` and `ScellTenantClient.fiscal`.

The fiscal system implements the French ISCA standard: an immutable SHA-256 hash chain of all fiscal entries, periodic closings, TSA anchoring (RFC 3161), FEC export for French tax authorities, and attestation certificates.

```typescript
const fiscal = client.fiscal;

// --- Compliance status ---
const compliance: FiscalComplianceData = await fiscal.getCompliance();
console.log(compliance.status, compliance.chain_integrity);

// --- Integrity ---
// Run integrity check
const report: FiscalIntegrityReport = await fiscal.checkIntegrity({
  from_date: '2026-01-01',
  to_date: '2026-03-31',
});
console.log(report.overall_status, report.chain_valid);

// Get integrity history
const { data } = await fiscal.getIntegrityHistory({ page: 1, per_page: 20 });

// --- Closings ---
// List closings
const { data: closings } = await fiscal.listClosings({ type: 'monthly', per_page: 20 });

// Create daily closing
const { data: closing } = await fiscal.createDailyClosing({ date: '2026-03-31' });
console.log('Hash:', closing.hash);

// --- Entries ---
// List fiscal entries (the immutable ledger)
const { data: entries } = await fiscal.listEntries({
  date_from: '2026-03-01',
  date_to: '2026-03-31',
  per_page: 100,
});

// --- FEC Export (for French tax authorities) ---
const fecResult: FiscalFecExportResult = await fiscal.exportFec({
  year: 2026,
  month: 3,       // optional: March only; omit for full year
  format: 'csv',
});
// fecResult.url (download URL), fecResult.entries_count

// --- Attestation (ISCA annual certificate) ---
const { data: attestations } = await fiscal.listAttestations({ per_page: 10 });

// Generate attestation
const { data: attestation } = await fiscal.generateAttestation();

// Download attestation as PDF (ArrayBuffer)
const pdfBuffer: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.downloadAttestationPdf('attestation-uuid');
// Save to file:
// writeFileSync('attestation.pdf', Buffer.from(pdfBuffer));

// --- ISCA Self-Attestation NOMINATIVE (since v1.17.0) ---
// PDF includes the beneficiary identity (legal_name, SIRET, VAT number,
// address, contact, KYB/KYC status) + software name + version + editor.
// SHA-256 hash covers the beneficiary block — non-transferable proof.

// For the authenticated tenant (KYB data)
const tenantPdf: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.iscaSelfAttestationDownload();
// writeFileSync('attestation-tenant.pdf', Buffer.from(tenantPdf));

// For a specific sub_tenant (404 if not found or not owned by tenant)
const subPdf: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.iscaSelfAttestationDownload('019d5ea8-...');
// writeFileSync('attestation-sub-tenant.pdf', Buffer.from(subPdf));

// Non-nominative compliance documents
const measures: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.iscaMeasuresRegisterDownload();
const dossier: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.iscaTechnicalDossierDownload();

// --- ISCA Annual Report ---
// Download ISCA annual report PDF (ArrayBuffer)
const reportBuffer: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.downloadAnnualReportPdf({ year: 2026 });

// --- TSA Anchors ---
const { data: anchors } = await fiscal.listAnchors({ date_from: '2026-01-01' });

// Trigger manual anchor (TSA timestamp)
const { data: anchor } = await fiscal.createAnchor();

// --- Rules ---
const { data: rules } = await fiscal.listRules({ category: 'invoice', is_active: true });
const { data: rule } = await fiscal.createRule({ category: 'invoice', name: 'R001', description: 'Rule description' });
await fiscal.updateRule('rule-uuid', { is_active: false });
await fiscal.deleteRule('rule-uuid');
const { data: result } = await fiscal.replayRules({ from_date: '2026-01-01', to_date: '2026-03-31' });
const exportedRules = await fiscal.exportRules({ format: 'json' });

// --- Kill Switch ---
const { data: killSwitch } = await fiscal.getKillSwitch();
console.log('Status:', killSwitch.status); // 'active' | 'inactive'

// Activate kill switch (EMERGENCY ONLY — disables invoice creation)
await fiscal.activateKillSwitch({ reason: 'Security incident detected' });

// Deactivate kill switch
await fiscal.deactivateKillSwitch();

// --- Forensic Export ---
const forensicBuffer: ArrayBuffer = await fiscal.forensicExport({
  type: 'full',
  from_date: '2026-01-01',
  to_date: '2026-03-31',
});
```

---

## Webhook Verification

Use `ScellWebhooks` to verify that incoming webhook requests are authentic.

Scell signs each webhook delivery with HMAC-SHA256. The `Scell-Signature` header format is:
`t={unix_timestamp},v1={hex_encoded_hmac_sha256}`

The signed payload is: `{timestamp}.{raw_json_body}`

### Async (Web Crypto API — works in browsers and Node.js 18+)

```typescript
import { ScellWebhooks } from '@scell/sdk';

// Express.js example
app.post('/webhooks/scell', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), async (req, res) => {
  const signature = req.headers['scell-signature'] as string;
  const webhookSecret = process.env.SCELL_WEBHOOK_SECRET!;

  const isValid = await ScellWebhooks.verifySignature(
    req.body,     // raw Buffer or string
    signature,    // 't=...,v1=...'
    webhookSecret,
    { tolerance: 300 } // optional: seconds to allow timestamp drift (default: 300)
  );

  if (!isValid) {
    return res.status(400).send('Invalid signature');
  }

  // Parse and handle event
  const event = ScellWebhooks.parsePayload<InvoiceWebhookData>(req.body);
  console.log('Event type:', event.event);
  console.log('Event ID:', event.id);

  switch (event.event) {
    case 'invoice.validated':
      await handleInvoiceValidated(event.data.invoice);
      break;
    case 'invoice.rejected':
      await handleInvoiceRejected(event.data.invoice);
      break;
    case 'invoice.incoming.received':
      await handleIncomingInvoice(event.data.invoice);
      break;
  }

  res.status(200).send('OK');
});
```

### Sync (Node.js crypto — server-side only)

```typescript
import { ScellWebhooks } from '@scell/sdk';

const isValid = ScellWebhooks.verifySignatureSync(
  rawBody,    // Buffer or string
  signature,  // 't=...,v1=...'
  secret,
  { tolerance: 300 }
);
```

### `ScellWebhooks` API

```typescript
// Async verification (Web Crypto — Node.js 18+ and browsers)
ScellWebhooks.verifySignature(
  payload: string | Buffer,
  signature: string,
  secret: string,
  options?: VerifySignatureOptions
): Promise<boolean>

interface VerifySignatureOptions {
  tolerance?: number;  // seconds timestamp tolerance, default: 300
}

// Sync verification (Node.js crypto module — server only)
ScellWebhooks.verifySignatureSync(
  payload: string | Buffer,
  signature: string,
  secret: string,
  options?: VerifySignatureOptions
): boolean

// Parse raw payload to typed WebhookPayload
ScellWebhooks.parsePayload<T = unknown>(payload: string | Buffer): WebhookPayload<T>

// Construct a test event (useful for local testing)
ScellWebhooks.constructTestEvent(
  event: WebhookEvent,
  data: unknown,
  secret: string
): { payload: string; signature: string }
```

---

## Retry Configuration

The SDK retries failed requests automatically with exponential backoff and jitter. By default: 3 retries, starting at 500ms, max 10s.

```typescript
import { withRetry, createRetryWrapper } from '@scell/sdk';

// Wrap a single call with custom retry
const result = await withRetry(
  () => client.invoices.create({ ... }),
  { maxRetries: 5, initialDelay: 1000, maxDelay: 30000, jitter: true }
);

// Create a reusable retry wrapper
const retryFetch = createRetryWrapper({ maxRetries: 3 });
const invoice = await retryFetch(() => client.invoices.get('invoice-uuid'));
```

Retryable errors (automatically retried): network errors, timeouts, `ScellServerError` (500), `ScellRateLimitError` (429).
Non-retryable (not retried): `ScellValidationError` (422), `ScellAuthenticationError` (401), `ScellAuthorizationError` (403), `ScellNotFoundError` (404), `ScellInsufficientBalanceError` (402).

---

## Rate Limits

| Endpoint Category | Limit |
|---|---|
| Invoice creation | 100/min |
| Signature creation | 50/min |
| General API reads | 500/min |
| Webhook test | 10/min |
| Auth (login) | 10/min |

When rate limited, a `ScellRateLimitError` is thrown with `retryAfter` (seconds).

```typescript
    line1: '1 Rue de la Paix',
    postal_code: '75001',
    city: 'Paris',
    country: 'FR',
  },
  buyer_siret: '98765432109876',

    line1: '2 Avenue des Champs-Élysées',

    city: 'Paris',

```
