### Example 5: Full incoming invoice lifecycle

```typescript
const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// 1. List pending incoming invoices
const { data: pending } = await client.invoices.incoming({ status: 'pending', per_page: 50 });

for (const invoice of pending) {
  // 2a. Accept and schedule payment
  if (isApproved(invoice)) {
    await client.invoices.accept(invoice.id, {
      payment_date: '2026-04-30',
      note: 'Approved by accounting',
    });

    // 3. Later, mark as paid
    await client.invoices.markPaid(invoice.id, {
      payment_reference: 'VIR-2026-0199',
      paid_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      note: 'Paid via bank transfer',
    });

  // 2b. Reject
  } else if (isRejected(invoice)) {
    await client.invoices.reject(invoice.id, {
      reason: 'Invoice amount does not match purchase order',
      reason_code: 'incorrect_amount',
    });

  // 2c. Open dispute
  } else {
    await client.invoices.dispute(invoice.id, {
      reason: 'Quantity billed exceeds what was delivered',
      dispute_type: 'amount_dispute',
      expected_amount: invoice.total_ttc * 0.8,
    });
  }
}
```

### Example 6: Create and monitor an e-signature request

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// Create signature request
const pdfBase64 = readFileSync('contract.pdf').toString('base64');
const { data: sig } = await client.signatures.create({
  title: 'Service Agreement — Q2 2026',
  document: pdfBase64,
  document_name: 'service-agreement-q2-2026.pdf',
  message: 'Please review and sign this agreement.',
  signers: [
    {
      name: 'Alice Martin',
      email: 'alice@client.com',
      auth_method: 'email',
      position: { page: 4, x: 100, y: 700, width: 200, height: 50 },
    },
    {
      name: 'Bob Smith',
      email: 'bob@mycompany.com',
      auth_method: 'sms',
      phone: '+33612345678',
    },
  ],
  ui_config: {
    sidebar_logo: 'https://mycompany.com/logo.png',
    sidebar_background_color: '#2563EB',
    sidebar_title_color: '#ffffff',
    sign_button_background_color: '#10B981',
    iframe_ancestors: ['https://app.mycompany.com'],
  },
  signature_options: {
    signature_mode: 'both',
    signer_must_read: true,
    user_editable_data: { name: false, mobile: true, email: false },
    timezone: 'Europe/Paris',
  },
  expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
});

console.log('Signature request ID:', sig.id);
console.log('Status:', sig.status); // 'pending'

// Poll status
async function pollSignature(id: string) {
  const { data: sig } = await client.signatures.get(id);

  if (sig.status === 'completed') {
    const { url } = await client.signatures.download(id, 'pdf');
    console.log('Download signed document:', url);
    return sig;
  }

  if (sig.status === 'rejected' || sig.status === 'cancelled') {
    const rejecter = sig.signers.find(s => s.status === 'rejected');
    console.log('Rejected by:', rejecter?.email, rejecter?.rejection_reason);
    return sig;
  }

  // Send reminders to pending signers
  const pending = sig.signers.filter(s => s.status === 'pending');
  if (pending.length > 0) {
    const { reminded_count } = await client.signatures.remind(id);
    console.log(`Reminded ${reminded_count} pending signers`);
  }

  // Check again in 5 minutes
  setTimeout(() => pollSignature(id), 5 * 60 * 1000);
}

pollSignature(sig.id);
```

### Example 7: Webhook handler with HMAC verification

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { ScellWebhooks, InvoiceWebhookData, SignatureWebhookData } from '@scell/sdk';

const app = express();

app.post('/webhooks/scell', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), async (req, res) => {
  const signature = req.headers['scell-signature'] as string;

  const isValid = await ScellWebhooks.verifySignature(
    req.body,
    signature,
    process.env.SCELL_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
    { tolerance: 300 }
  );

  if (!isValid) {
    console.error('Invalid webhook signature');
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
  }

  const event = ScellWebhooks.parsePayload(req.body);

  switch (event.event) {
    case 'invoice.validated':
    case 'invoice.submitted': {
      const { invoice } = event.data as InvoiceWebhookData;
      console.log(`Invoice ${invoice.invoice_number} — ${event.event}`);
      await updateInvoiceStatus(invoice.id, invoice.status);
      break;
    }
    case 'invoice.rejected': {
      const { invoice } = event.data as InvoiceWebhookData;
      await handleRejectedInvoice(invoice);
      break;
    }
    case 'invoice.incoming.received': {
      const { invoice } = event.data as InvoiceWebhookData;
      await queueIncomingInvoiceReview(invoice);
      break;
    }
    case 'signature.completed': {
      const { signature } = event.data as SignatureWebhookData;
      await handleSignatureCompleted(signature);
      break;
    }
    case 'balance.low': {
      await sendLowBalanceAlert(event.data);
      break;
    }
  }

  res.status(200).json({ received: true });
});
```

### Example 8: SuperPDP OAuth2 onboarding flow (complete)

```typescript
// Frontend (React) — using ScellPublicClient
import { ScellPublicClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellPublicClient(process.env.REACT_APP_SCELL_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!);

async function startOnboarding() {
  // 1. Create session
  const { data: session } = await client.onboarding.createSession();

  // 2. Get authorize URL
  const { authorize_url, state } = await client.onboarding.getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl(session.id);

  // 3. Store for callback verification
  sessionStorage.setItem('scell_state', state);
  sessionStorage.setItem('scell_session_id', session.id);

  // 4. Open SuperPDP popup
  const popup = window.open(authorize_url, 'scell-onboarding', 'width=850,height=750');

  // 5. Listen for postMessage from popup (after SuperPDP redirects back)
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    window.addEventListener('message', async (event) => {
      if (!event.data?.code) return;

      const { code, state: receivedState } = event.data;
      const savedState = sessionStorage.getItem('scell_state');
      const savedSessionId = sessionStorage.getItem('scell_session_id');

      if (receivedState !== savedState) {
        return reject(new Error('State mismatch'));
      }

      popup?.close();

      // 6. Exchange code for tenant credentials
      const result = await client.onboarding.superpdpCallback(savedSessionId!, code, receivedState);

      if (result.success) {
        // Send tenant credentials to your backend (DO NOT store api_key client-side)
        await fetch('/api/onboarding/complete', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ tenant: result.tenant }),
        });
        resolve(result.tenant);
      } else {
        reject(new Error('Onboarding failed'));
      }
    }, { once: true });
  });
}
```

### Example 9: Sub-tenant provisioning with ScellApiClient

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const platformClient = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_PLATFORM_API_KEY!);

async function provisionTenant(customer: Customer) {
  const { data: tenant } = await platformClient.subTenants.create({
    name: customer.companyName,
    siret: customer.siret,
    address: {
      line1: customer.address.street,
      postal_code: customer.address.zip,
      city: customer.address.city,
      country: 'FR',
    },
    email: customer.email,
    external_id: customer.id,  // your CRM/DB identifier
  });

  // Credentials are ONLY returned on create — store them immediately
  await db.tenants.create({
    scell_tenant_id: tenant.id,
    scell_api_key: tenant.api_key,         // sk_live_xxx
    scell_tenant_key: tenant.tenant_key,   // tk_live_xxx
    scell_publishable_key: tenant.publishable_key, // pk_live_xxx
    customer_id: customer.id,
  });

  return tenant;
}

// Later: use the tenant's own key
async function createInvoiceForTenant(tenantApiKey: string, invoiceData: CreateInvoiceInput) {
  const tenantClient = new ScellApiClient(tenantApiKey);
  const { data: invoice } = await tenantClient.invoices.create(invoiceData);
  await tenantClient.invoices.submit(invoice.id);
  return invoice;
}
```

### Example 12: Fiscal compliance check and FEC export

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';
import { writeFileSync } from 'fs';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// 1. Check compliance status
const compliance = await client.fiscal.getCompliance();
if (compliance.status !== 'compliant') {
  console.warn('Non-compliant! Issues:', compliance.issues.length);
  compliance.issues
    .filter(i => !i.resolved)
    .forEach(i => console.error(`[${i.severity}] ${i.description}`));
}

// 2. Run integrity check for Q1 2026
const report = await client.fiscal.checkIntegrity({
  from_date: '2026-01-01',
  to_date: '2026-03-31',
});
console.log('Integrity:', report.chain_valid ? 'VALID' : 'BROKEN');

// 3. Create daily closing
const { data: closing } = await client.fiscal.createDailyClosing({ date: '2026-03-31' });
console.log('Closing hash:', closing.hash);

// 4. Export FEC for March 2026 (for tax authorities)
const fec = await client.fiscal.exportFec({ year: 2026, month: 3, format: 'csv' });
console.log('FEC export URL:', fec.url, '— expires:', fec.expires_at);
console.log('Entries:', fec.entries_count);

// 5. Generate and download ISCA attestation
const { data: attestation } = await client.fiscal.generateAttestation();
const pdfBuffer = await client.fiscal.downloadAttestationPdf(attestation.id);
writeFileSync('isca-attestation-2026.pdf', Buffer.from(pdfBuffer));

// 6. Download ISCA annual report
const reportBuffer = await client.fiscal.downloadAnnualReportPdf({ year: 2026 });
writeFileSync('isca-annual-report-2026.pdf', Buffer.from(reportBuffer));
```

### Example 13: Error handling with retry

```typescript
import {
  ScellApiClient,
  ScellValidationError,
  ScellInsufficientBalanceError,
  ScellRateLimitError,
  ScellNetworkError,
  withRetry,
} from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!, {
  retry: { maxRetries: 3, initialDelay: 500, maxDelay: 10000, jitter: true },
});

async function createInvoiceSafely(input: CreateInvoiceInput) {
  try {
    // SDK retries automatically on 429/500/network errors
    const { data: invoice } = await client.invoices.create(input);
    return invoice;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ScellValidationError) {
      // Fix validation errors before retrying
      console.error('Validation failed:', error.errors);
      // error.errors = { 'seller_siret': ['Invalid SIRET'], 'lines.0.tax_rate': ['Must be 0, 5.5, 10, or 20'] }
      throw error; // don't retry, fix the input
    }

    if (error instanceof ScellInsufficientBalanceError) {
      console.error(`Need ${error.required}€ but only have ${error.balance}€`);
      await topUpBalance(error.required! - error.balance!);
      // Retry manually
      return createInvoiceSafely(input);
    }

    if (error instanceof ScellRateLimitError) {
      console.warn(`Rate limited. Wait ${error.retryAfter}s.`);
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, (error.retryAfter ?? 60) * 1000));
      return createInvoiceSafely(input);
    }

    if (error instanceof ScellNetworkError) {
      console.error('Network issue:', error.cause?.message);
      // Use withRetry for manual retry with custom options
      return withRetry(() => client.invoices.create(input), { maxRetries: 5 });
    }

    throw error;
  }
}
```

### Example 14: Save a signed PDF to disk (Node.js)

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';
import { writeFileSync } from 'fs';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// Download invoice as binary PDF
const pdfBuffer = await client.invoices.downloadFile('invoice-uuid', 'pdf');
writeFileSync('invoice.pdf', Buffer.from(pdfBuffer));

// Download invoice as XML (UBL/CII)
const xmlBuffer = await client.invoices.downloadFile('invoice-uuid', 'xml');
writeFileSync('invoice.xml', Buffer.from(xmlBuffer));

// Download signed signature document
const sigBuffer = await (async () => {
  const { url } = await client.signatures.download('sig-uuid', 'pdf');
  const resp = await fetch(url);
  return resp.arrayBuffer();
})();
writeFileSync('signed-contract.pdf', Buffer.from(sigBuffer));
```

### Example 15: Browser — trigger invoice download

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient(apiKey);

async function downloadInvoicePdf(invoiceId: string) {
  // Option A: Download URL (expires in ~15 min)
  const { url } = await client.invoices.download(invoiceId, 'pdf');
  window.open(url, '_blank');

  // Option B: Binary download (use for creating Blob)
  const buffer = await client.invoices.downloadFile(invoiceId, 'pdf');
  const blob = new Blob([buffer], { type: 'application/pdf' });
  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = objectUrl;
  a.download = `invoice-${invoiceId}.pdf`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
}
```

### Example 16: Billing — usage and top-up

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// Check usage for current month
const { data: usage } = await client.billing.usage({ year: 2026, month: 3 });
console.log(`Invoices: ${usage.invoices_count} (${usage.invoices_cost}€)`);
console.log(`Signatures: ${usage.signatures_count} (${usage.signatures_cost}€)`);
console.log(`Total: ${usage.total_cost}€`);

// List platform invoices
const { data: invoices } = await client.billing.invoices({ date_from: '2026-01-01' });

// Download a specific billing invoice PDF
const pdfBuffer = await client.billing.downloadInvoice(invoices[0].id);

// Top up balance (creates Stripe payment intent)
const { data: topup } = await client.billing.topUp({ amount: 100.00 });
// Complete payment with Stripe.js on the client side, then confirm
await client.billing.confirmTopUp({ payment_intent_id: topup.payment_intent_id });
```

### Example 17: Statistics

```typescript
import { ScellApiClient } from '@scell/sdk';

const client = new ScellApiClient(process.env.SCELL_API_KEY!);

// Overall stats
const { data: overview } = await client.stats.overview();
console.log('Total invoices:', overview.invoices_total);
console.log('Total tenants:', overview.tenants_count);

// Monthly breakdown
const { data: monthly } = await client.stats.monthly({
  date_from: '2026-01-01',
  date_to: '2026-03-31',
});
monthly.forEach(m => {
  console.log(`${m.month}: ${m.invoices_count} invoices, ${m.signatures_count} signatures`);
});

// Stats for a specific sub-tenant
const { data: tenantStats } = await client.stats.subTenantOverview('tenant-uuid');
```

## Webhook Events Reference

| Event | Trigger |
|---|---|
| `invoice.created` | Invoice draft created |
| `invoice.updated` | Invoice data updated |
| `invoice.submitted` | Invoice submitted for processing |
| `invoice.validated` | Invoice validated by Scell/SuperPDP |
| `invoice.rejected` | Invoice rejected (with reason) |
| `invoice.cancelled` | Invoice cancelled |
| `invoice.paid` | Invoice marked as paid |
| `invoice.disputed` | Invoice disputed |
| `invoice.accepted` | Incoming invoice accepted by buyer |
| `invoice.incoming.received` | New incoming invoice received |
| `invoice.incoming.paid` | Incoming invoice marked paid by buyer |
| `signature.created` | Signature request created |
| `signature.completed` | All signers have signed |
| `signature.rejected` | At least one signer rejected |
| `signature.cancelled` | Signature request cancelled |
| `signature.expired` | Signature request expired |
| `signature.signer.signed` | Individual signer completed |
| `signature.signer.rejected` | Individual signer rejected |
| `balance.updated` | Balance changed |
| `balance.low` | Balance dropped below threshold |
| `balance.reloaded` | Balance was topped up |

---

## Sandbox Mode

Use `sk_test_*` / `pk_test_*` keys to work against the sandbox database without affecting production data or billing.

```typescript
// Sandbox — same base URL, different key prefix
const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_test_xxx');

// The backend automatically routes to sandbox DB based on key prefix
// sk_live_* → production database
// sk_test_* → sandbox database
```

There is **no** separate sandbox base URL (no `api-sandbox.scell.io`). Everything goes through `https://api.scell.io/api/v1`.

---

## Migration Notes

### v1.12.0 — ScellPublicClient

Added `ScellPublicClient` for browser/widget use with `pk_live_*` / `pk_test_*` keys. Previously only `ScellApiClient` supported onboarding; now use `ScellPublicClient` for client-side flows.

```typescript
// Before v1.12.0
const client = new ScellApiClient('sk_live_xxx');
const { data: session } = await client.onboarding.createSession();

// v1.12.0+ (recommended for client-side)
const client = new ScellPublicClient('pk_live_xxx');
const { data: session } = await client.onboarding.createSession();
```

### v1.11.0 — SuperPDP OAuth2 Onboarding

Added `OnboardingResource` to `ScellApiClient` with `createSession`, `getSession`, `getSuperPDPAuthorizeUrl`, `superpdpCallback` methods.

### v1.9.2 — ISCA Compliance

Added `downloadAttestationPdf()` and `downloadAnnualReportPdf()` to `FiscalResource`. These return `ArrayBuffer` (binary PDF content).

### v1.9.0 — Server-Generated Invoice Numbers

Invoice numbers are now **fully server-generated**. Removed `invoice_number` from `CreateInvoiceInput`. If your code previously passed `invoice_number`, remove it — the field will be ignored or cause a validation error.

```typescript
// WRONG (will fail on v1.9.0+)
await client.invoices.create({ invoice_number: 'INV-001', ... });

// CORRECT
await client.invoices.create({ direction: 'outgoing', output_format: 'facturx', ... });
// Invoice number assigned by server: 'DRAFT-XXXXX-00001'
```

### v1.8.0 — International Invoicing

Added support for EU buyers (via `buyer_vat_number`) and non-EU buyers (via `buyer_legal_id` + `buyer_legal_id_scheme`). Previously only French SIRET was supported for buyers.

### v1.4.0 — Fiscal, Billing, Stats

Added `FiscalResource`, `BillingResource`, `StatsResource` to `ScellApiClient`.

### v1.2.0 — Mark Paid and Download File

Added `markPaid()` to `InvoicesResource` and `downloadFile()` for binary PDF/XML downloads.

---

## TypeScript Tips

```typescript
// Import all types
import type {
  Invoice,
  CreateInvoiceInput,
  InvoiceStatus,
  Signature,
  CreateSignatureInput,
  WebhookPayload,
  InvoiceWebhookData,
  TenantProfile,
  FiscalComplianceData,
  ClientConfig,
  PaginatedResponse,
  SingleResponse,
  ScellError,
} from '@scell/sdk';

// Narrow webhook event types
function handleWebhook(payload: WebhookPayload) {
  if (payload.event === 'invoice.validated') {
    const { invoice } = payload.data as InvoiceWebhookData;
    console.log(invoice.invoice_number, invoice.status);
  }
}

// Use generic helpers
async function fetchAllPages<T>(
  fetcher: (page: number) => Promise<PaginatedResponse<T>>
): Promise<T[]> {
  const all: T[] = [];
  let page = 1;
  let lastPage = 1;
  do {
    const { data, meta } = await fetcher(page);
    all.push(...data);
    lastPage = meta.last_page;
    page++;
  } while (page <= lastPage);
  return all;
}

const allInvoices = await fetchAllPages(page =>
  client.invoices.list({ per_page: 100, page })
);
```

## Signature blocks (v2.17.0 — paraphe multi-page, mentions, date)

`client.signatures.create()` accepts 3 optional fields: `initials_block`,
`mentions`, `date_block`. All use snake_case (matches the API payload).

### Multi-page initials (v2.17.0)

Two formats supported. The new `positions[]` (one entry per page) wins over
legacy `position + pages` if both are provided.

```typescript
import type {
  CreateSignatureInput,
  InitialsBlock,
  InitialsPosition,
} from '@scell/sdk';

// NEW (v2.17.0) — positions[] with per-page overrides
const initialsBlock: InitialsBlock = {
  enabled: true,
  mode: 'auto',
  source: 'signer_name',
  font_size: 10,
  color: '#000000',
  bold: false,
  positions: [
    { page: 1, x: 90, y: 90, unit: 'percent' },
    { page: 2, x: 88, y: 92, unit: 'percent', font_size: 12 },
    { page: 3, x: 85, y: 90, unit: 'percent', color: '#AA0000' },
  ],
};

// LEGACY — still supported
const legacyBlock: InitialsBlock = {
  enabled: true,
  mode: 'auto',
  source: 'signer_name',
  pages: 'except_last',  // 'all' | 'except_last' | number[]
  position: { x: 90, y: 95, unit: 'percent' },
  font_size: 10,
  color: '#333333',
};

await client.signatures.create({
  title: 'Contrat',
  document: base64Pdf,
  document_name: 'contract.pdf',
  signers: [{ first_name: 'Jean', last_name: 'Dupont', email: 'jean@example.com', auth_method: 'email' }],
  initials_block: initialsBlock,
});
```

### Mentions + Date

```typescript
import type { Mention, DateBlock } from '@scell/sdk';

const mentions: Mention[] = [{
  label: 'Lu et approuvé',
  required: true,
  signer_index: 0,
  position: { page: 1, x: 10, y: 80, unit: 'percent' },
}];

const dateBlock: DateBlock = {
  enabled: true,
  format: 'dd/MM/yyyy',
  timezone: 'Europe/Paris',
  position: { page: 'last', x: 80, y: 10, unit: 'percent' },
};

await client.signatures.create({
  // ... signers, document ...
  mentions,
  date_block: dateBlock,
});
```

Types exposés depuis `@scell/sdk` :
- `InitialsBlock` — bloc paraphe (accepte positions[] + legacy)
- `InitialsPosition` — **NEW v2.17.0** position individuelle
- `SignatureBlockPosition` — position générique (legacy initials, sans page)
- `Mention` + `MentionPosition` — mention juridique
- `DateBlock` + `DateBlockPosition` — bloc date (supporte page: 'last')
